blocks.heading: SEE (Grade Increment) 2082 (2026) Computer Science - Optional Second
blocks.paragraph: This is the SEE Grade Increment 2082 (2026 AD) question paper for Computer Science, Optional Second subject, paper code GI-3031. It carries full marks of 50 and an allotted time of 2 hours, divided into Group A (short, one-line answers and terminology), Group B (short/medium answers including QBASIC program tracing and debugging), and Group C (numerical conversions and full program-writing questions in QBASIC and C).

items.source: SEE Grade Increment 2082 (2026) Computer Science Optional II
items.question: Write down the output of the given program and show it in a dry run table.
items.code:
DECLARE SUB SERIES ()
CLS
CALL SERIES
END

SUB SERIES
FOR J = 5 TO 1 STEP -1
    FOR I = 1 TO J
        PRINT I;
    NEXT I
    PRINT
NEXT J
END SUB

questionSections.title: Group B - Q6: Correct the bugs in the given program

items.source: SEE Grade Increment 2082 (2026) Computer Science Optional II
items.question: Rewrite the given program after correcting the bugs.
items.code:
REM to add more data in sequential data file
Open "REC. DAT" FOR OUTPUT AS #1
DO
    INPUT "Enter Name"; N$
    INPUT "Enter Address"; A$
    INPUT "Enter class with section"; C$
    INPUT "Enter Roll no."; RN
    INPUT #2, N$, A$, C$, RN
    INPUT "Do you want to continue"; CH$
LOOP WHILE UCASE$(CH$) = "Y"
CLOSE
END

questionSections.title: Group B - Q7: Study the given program and answer the questions

items.source: SEE Grade Increment 2082 (2026) Computer Science Optional II
items.question: Write the Real parameter and Formal parameter used in the above program.
items.code:
DECLARE FUNCTION SUM (N)
CLS
A = 1234
Y = SUM (A)
PRINT "Sum of individual digits"; Y
END

FUNCTION SUM (N)
    WHILE N<>0
        D = N MOD 10
        S = S+D
        N = INT (N/10)
    WEND
    SUM = S
END FUNCTION
